notes.title: Quick update + Discounts + Steam Award 🏆

notes.title: Game Update v1.5 ⚙️
notes.notes:
Fighters from this world and from the other! How are you? 👻

Since the release of last month, creator Andres Borghi has been working on improvements and fixes for The Black Heart. And today we have the new version 1.5 ready, which includes:


 New options on Practice Mode

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/9c5990c55900e8a95dc3dff707055e28321fe8ea.jpg


 Fixes and visual tweaks for the interface

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/cb594bd95caf20085e1acdfba405044336fe549c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/dc8bb89fbb7708e681f69d048570e50159d1b066.jpg


 Balancing improvements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/e47963c7d619b03c40d383156d9657ca11f18d52.jpg

And a lot more! Below you will find the full change log 👇


Don’t stop playing the game and giving us all your valuable feedback! And remember to follow us on our social networks for more content:

 Twitter
 Facebook
 Instagram (Andres)
 You Tube (Andres)
 Discord (fanmade)

Cheers and let’s try out the new 1.5 version!

Tobias

-

Lista completa de ajustes y mejoras en la nueva versión 1.5

General:

 Improved Practice mode with more options.
 Fixed image bug in movelists.
 Added macros to execute double punch or kick with 1 key.
 Updated engine to Ikemen_GO_v0.98.1
 In Practice mode you can choose any stage.
 Changed background animation in options menu.
 Every normal launcher can be blocked mid-air.
 Fatal moves performed in Practice mode don't produce bugs.
 Killer modes executed mid-combo consume half a green bar for every character.
 Normal weak jumping attacks produce more stunts to standing enemies to facilitate combos.


Peketo:

 "tele-cut" uses 2 different animations varying between weak or strong.
 "Tele-cut" is slightly slower.


Ananzi:

 "Super crawling birth" bounces only 2 times before disappearing.
 "Super crawling birth" allows only 1 egg onscreen.
 "Arachnid requiem" is faster and produces slightly more damage.
 Animation for "Super black trap" is a little faster during HIT.
 "Prey" is now overhead.
 You need more distance from the enemy to execute "Black trap".


Animus:

 Weak "Nadasdy spear" now leaves the enemy closer when hit.
 JP-HK in dash is not overhead anymore.


Shar-makai:

 "Saliva attack" is now a hard knockdown.
 St-hp has more reach.
 Fatal move has more reach and is unblockable.
 "Small army" allows to continue the combo.
 Jp-lp has cooldown to prevent constant spamming.
 Worm spawned in "Rock skull" now dies if Shar-makai is hit.
 St-hk is now overhead, except during combo.


Hashi:

 "Seeding" tree now has more pushback when blocked.


Noroko:

 "Snow woman" can be executed only 2 times without touching the floor.
 Reduced juggle.
 "Soul Punishment", "Bloody end" and "Kwaidan" have more recovery.


Final:

 "Sanguimancy" clones now die after a certain time.


Janos:

 Fixed some hitboxes
 "Negative saw is now executable in mid-air and is now a launcher.
 Projectiles in "Black blade" and "Black blades shred" are destroyed when clashing against an enemy projectile.
 "Dark puppet" clon has less life and last less time.
 There can only be 1 "Dark Puppet" onscreen.

notes.title: 🖤 Full Release Announcement! 🖤
notes.notes:
Creatures from the other world! How are you? 💀

We finally have a full Steam release date for The Black Heart:

🔥 OCTOBER 21 IS THE DAY! 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/9e2748f79ab6bfcc848c4be7f5ade9417c160a10.jpg

In just 4 weeks, the game will go from the current Early Access state, to its FINAL form. And it will include:

 Chapter 6 of the Story Mode (Shar-makai)
 New and improved unlockable palettes for all characters
 A Gallery with all the cinematics
 Final as an unlockable playable character
 Remastered music by David Levill
 And also… A BIG SURPRISE! Which we’re going to reveal on launch

Today starts the final countdown for a project in which Andrés Borghi started working almost 2 decades ago...

That’s why we want to ask you, our lovely and faithful fans from the other world, to follow and support us as much as you can during this campaign for the definitive release.

From Saibot Studios and together with Andrés, we’re going to post a lot of things in our social media accounts, so The Black Heart can reach even more gamers all around the world when the final release arrives. But we need your help 🙌


Follow us and share our posts:

Tobías and Andrés

notes.title: Biggest update coming this month! 😈
notes.notes:
Creatures from the underworld! How are you? It’s been a while...

We haven’t tell you much news lately about The Black Heart and that’s because we’ve been (and still are) super busy working on THE BIGGEST UPDATE TO DATE 🤯

Besides the so long awaited chapter 5 of the Story Mode (starring the beautiful Ananzi), we’re doing all kinds of improvements, fixes and even adding new features to the game. But we won't tell you anything about that yet, you will discover it soon enough...

We’ll try to have the update ready during what is left in this month of May. If we can’t make it for next week, it will be for the other without excuses 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38883735/c58634334c140925926a8dd9cc50c1ddcda2b05c.jpg

In the next days we’re going to adjust the price of the Early Access, since all the new features coming in this next update have required some additional programming outsourcing 💸

So if you didn’t get the game yet on Steam, do it now before the price increases!

The final game of The Black Heart is coming together super well... Together with Andrés we are very happy with the results coming in this new update, and hope you guys like it as much as we do 🤓

Cheers and have you all the most creepy and bloody weekend!

Tobías

Tobías
